snippet.title: Flecto - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Flecto is a puzzle game where you place blocks in order to deflect bullets and shatter targets. Strategically use your tiles to split bullets, bounce them around each level, and destroy every target.

The game will be released in 2026.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4143420/Flecto?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=announce_trailer_description
Press kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1bnB0jh_1WPhNzt-H94LcbVPcF66mXmpm
Official website: https://nightfoxdigital.com
